svg.text: v6mesh: split a flat dual IPv6 Kubernetes stack into four modules
Two IPv6 Kubernetes clusters live in one flat Terraform root with count-indexed lists and hard-coded names. The agent splits it into network, bootstrap, platform and
observability modules keyed by availability zone and worker pool, and the plan against production must contain nothing but moves.
